headline_cluster.headline: דווקא בשנה השלישית לטבח: הוכפל מספר הפניות של ילדים למיון פסיכיאטרי
זינוק אדיר בפניית ילדים למיון פסיכיאטרי ושימוש בתרופות
Shocking report: 121% rise in psychiatric ER visits among children and teens since Oct. 7th

primary_source_search_status: identified_via_secondary: Clalit Health Services 'three years of war' health snapshot (released ~2026-10-04; ~5M members; Oct 2023-Sep 2026 vs the two pre-war years). The Clalit document/press release itself was not located on clalit.co.il, so figures come from consistent search-indexed coverage (Haaretz, Maariv, N13, ynetnews, Israel Hayom, JDN). Direct fetches of ynet, walla, i24, ynetnews, maariv and jdn were all refused by the session's egress proxy (EGRESS_BLOCKED), so no article bodies were read.

primary_source.population: ~5 million Clalit members; psychiatric ER figure = children and adolescents
primary_source.baseline: two years before the war (Oct 2021 - Sep 2023)

figures.minirin_bedwetting_dispensing: +47.8% among children evacuated from the south (reported for war year 3 in some coverage)
figures.south_evacuees_new_PTSD_diagnoses: x18 year 1, x11 year 2, x6 year 3 (vs pre-war year)

clustering_note: Three outlets (ynet, walla, i24) covering what appears to be the same underlying report on children's/teens' psychiatric ER referrals since Oct 7, 2023. i24 gives the specific figure (121% rise); ynet says 'doubled'; walla adds medication-use angle. Likely same Ministry of Health / hospital-system data; verify whether all three cite the same report or different ones. AUDIT: confirmed all three are based on the same Clalit Health Services report; walla's 'medication' angle comes from that report's Minirin (bedwetting) figure.

claims.claim_text: דווקא בשנה השלישית לטבח: הוכפל מספר הפניות של ילדים למיון פסיכיאטרי
claims.source_figure: +121.3% in child/adolescent psychiatric ER visits in war year 3 (Oct 2025-Sep 2026) vs the two pre-war years; +78.3% in year 2. Clalit members only.
claims.note: 'Doubled in the third year' fits the year-3 figure (x2.21) and correctly ties it to year 3. 'Number of visits' (פניות) matches what was measured: visits, not unique patients. It leaves out that the data covers Clalit members only, which is a minor point. Body not read (blocked).

claims.claim_text: זינוק אדיר בפניית ילדים למיון פסיכיאטרי
claims.source_figure: +121.3% child/adolescent psychiatric ER visits in war year 3 vs pre-war baseline
claims.note: No number is given, but a 'huge surge' is supported by a rise of more than 100%. The search-indexed title of the same URL reads 'שלוש שנות מלחמה: זינוק של 121% בפניות ילדים למיון פסיכיאטרי', so the headline appears to have been revised. Body not read (blocked).

claims.claim_text: זינוק אדיר בפניית ילדים ... ושימוש בתרופות
claims.source_figure: +47.8% dispensing of Minirin (bedwetting medication) among children evacuated from the south
claims.note: The only child-medication figure found in the report is limited to a subgroup (children evacuated from the south) and a single drug (Minirin). The headline presents it as a general 'huge surge' in children's medication use. A 47.8% subgroup rise, added to a 121% ER figure, gets the same 'huge surge' wording. This is provisional: the walla body could not be read and may give context or other medication figures.

claims.claim_text: 121% rise in psychiatric ER visits among children and teens since Oct. 7th
claims.source_figure: +121.3% is the war year-3 figure (Oct 2025-Sep 2026) vs the pre-war baseline; year 2 was +78.3% (year 1 not found in coverage). Visits, not unique patients; Clalit members only.
claims.note: The number is correct, but 'since Oct. 7th' presents a single-year figure (year 3, the peak) as a total for the whole period since the attack. The rise over the full 3-year window would be lower. Haaretz used the same 'since Oct 7' framing. 'Shocking report' is framing and was not judged. Body not read (blocked).

audit_note: All three outlets report the same Clalit Health Services report, and the core 121% figure is reported correctly. The problems are framing: i24 presents the year-3 peak as a total 'since Oct 7', and walla generalizes a single-drug figure for evacuee children into a broad 'medication use' surge. The audit is partial because no article body could be read (proxy blocked) and the Clalit document itself was not retrieved; figures rely on consistent secondary coverage.
